items.quote: have you ever measured how much money your sales team is "leaving on the table"? The foundation of off-plan sales is crucial. Yet, surprisingly, 50% of agents selling off-plan struggle to understand how to share their screen effectively on Zoom.
items.statement: 50% of agents selling off-plan struggle to understand how to share their screen effectively on Zoom.

items.quote: In a recent 8-hour Zoom agent's exam: Product knowledge Ability to showcase numbers and follow the given structure were assessed. Even No Soft Skills been taken in consideration... Only 25% passed...
items.statement: Only 25% of participants passed a recent 8-hour Zoom agent's exam evaluating product knowledge and presentation abilities.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing key performance metrics for sales teams, specifically related to off-plan sales and Zoom presentation effectiveness.
